parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: ExportType
parameters.description:
The type of the object that is exported. Valid values:

*   transactionLog: transaction logs
*   snapshot: snapshots

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which the instance resides. The region is supported by Microservices Engine (MSE).

parameters.name: RequestPars
parameters.description: The extended request parameters in the JSON format.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse export-zookeeper-data --instance-id mse-cn-78v1l830000 --export-type snapshot --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --request-pars example-string --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse ExportZookeeperData --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId 'mse-cn-78v1l830000' --RequestPars 'example-string' --ExportType snapshot --AcceptLanguage zh --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
